Title: AVAN: Daily Affirmations
Short description: Personalized psychological affirmations, mindful meditation, and soundscapes.
Full description:
AVAN is a mindful daily affirmation and psychological reflection companion designed to cultivate self-belief, focus, and emotional resilience.

Key Features:
• Personalized Mindset Engine: Dynamic affirmations calibrated across 11 psychological archetypes using 16-dimensional cognitive embeddings.
• Calibrated Audio Pacing: Scientifically structured 18-second affirmation cycles (6 seconds of clear speech + 12 seconds of quiet reflection).
• Procedural Ambient Soundscapes: 100% offline 432Hz Miracle tones, 528Hz Solfeggio frequencies, gentle rainfall, and ocean waves.
• Say After Me: Interactive voice repetition to deeply reinforce affirmative reframes.
• My Voice Studio: Record and listen to affirmations spoken in your own voice.
• Mindful Reflections Journal: Track daily gratitude, thoughts, and mood shifts.
• Visual Vision Boards: Dynamic goal-setting templates with customizable color palettes.
• Dual Atmosphere Modes: Energizing Growth Mode and soothing somatic Healing Mode.

All user reflections and recordings remain 100% private on your device.

• Estudio de mi propia voz: Graba y escucha afirmaciones en tu propia voz.
• Diario de reflexiones conscientes: Registra tu gratitud diaria, pensamientos y estado de ánimo.
• Tableros de visión visuales: Plantillas dinámicas para metas con paletas de colores personalizables.
• Modos duales: Modo Crecimiento energizante y Modo Sanación relajante.
